name: The Surly Barkeep
effect: Pushing this layer-4 neuron negative makes the model brush off almost every request with a short "I'm sorry, no." and wander into naming liquor brands.
source: Qwen Pharmacopoeia: blind judges told it from the plain model on 40/40 held-out pairs. Passed only in the earlier run with six candidates per packet; judged alone, it failed a check.
